appearance_facts.fact: The title 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe' is centered at the top of the chart in a large, bold, black font.
A large orange-colored pie slice labeled 'Apple (45%)' occupies the top-left quadrant of the chart.
A medium-sized coral-colored pie slice labeled 'Xiaomi (30%)' occupies the bottom-left quadrant of the chart.
A medium-sized pale yellow-colored pie slice labeled 'Samsung (15%)' occupies the bottom-right quadrant of the chart.
A large red-colored pie slice labeled 'Others (10%)' occupies the top-right quadrant of the chart.
The center of the pie chart is empty white space, with no marks or text.

printed_facts.fact: The title 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe' is printed in black, bold, sans-serif font.
The text 'Apple (45%)' is printed in white within the orange slice.
The text 'Xiaomi (30%)' is printed in white within the coral slice.
The text 'Samsung (15%)' is printed in white within the pale yellow slice.
The text 'Others (10%)' is printed in white within the red slice.

public_definitions: The goal is to allocate the premium EU retail promotion budget to the brand with the highest current market share in Europe, as determined by the dashboard.
The dashboard's pie chart visually represents the market share percentages for each brand: Apple (45%), Xiaomi (30%), Samsung (15%), and Others (10%).
The 'Premium retail promotion brand' field in the form must be selected based on the market-share leader identified from the dashboard.

The form options are: 'Select Apple for the premium EU retail promotion budget', 'Select Others for the premium EU retail promotion budget', and 'Select Xiaomi for the premium EU retail promotion budget'.
uncertain: The dashboard does not explicitly state that the 'Others' category includes all brands not listed (Apple, Xiaomi, Samsung), but this is the only logical interpretation given the context and total market share (45% + 30% + 15% + 10% = 100%).
